about: The entry for provared-mcp-executor in package-lock.json beside this file was made from a pack of the working tree, before that version was on npm, and its hash is not npm's. Before a release tag carries this recipe: publish the executor, make the lockfile again from npm (npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts, in this folder), take this file away, and run node tools/release/check-recipe-lock.mjs --registry. That check fails while this file is here.
